angles: Embed the competitor inside the pipeline as a control arm. Add a phase that runs the single-strong-agent baseline itself (20 ideas, self-selected top 3) for the same brief before generation, then use those three ideas in two ways: (a) as explicit negative anchors in generator prompts, so independent generators are steered away from the modal region of idea-space the baseline will occupy rather than merely told to 'be diverse'; (b) as fixed reference opponents in the Bradley-Terry / Plackett-Luce finals, so an idea enters the system's top 3 only if its fitted strength exceeds the baseline anchors' with a stated margin, i.e. selection is 'beat the check' rather than 'best of ours'. A single agent cannot serve as its own control; the anchor also gives a within-run, on/off measurable effect (win rate vs anchors) before any external rating.

Treat the cross-run idea library as a training set for a learned selection prior, not an archive. After each benchmark run, record for every finalist its structural features (mechanism named vs theme, presence of a runnable check, number of surviving critiques, novelty distance to library neighbours, length) together with its blinded rater outcome vs the single-agent top 3. Fit a small logistic or ridge model mapping features to win probability and inject it as a Bayesian prior on Plackett-Luce strengths (or as a prior-weighted seeding of the pairwise schedule), and feed the top positive-weight features back into the critic rubric. The gain is a memory across briefs that one agent working on a single brief has no access to; it is isolable by zeroing the prior, and it self-corrects as the library grows.

domains.text: Agricultural variety trials with check cultivars. Plant breeders never rank candidate lines in isolation: a known check variety is sown in every block, candidate yield is expressed as a percentage of the check, and the check's spatial variation is used to correct for field heterogeneity (soil gradients, edge effects), the analogue of judge position and family bias. Multi-environment trials then advance only lines that beat the check across sites, and recurrent selection recombines survivors before the next cycle. Mechanisms to transfer: a reference entry in every pairwise block, blocking designs against positional bias, advancement thresholds stated relative to the check, and recombination of surviving ideas as the development step.

Germinal-centre affinity maturation in the immune system. B cells undergo cycles of somatic hypermutation in the dark zone, then compete in the light zone for a fixed antigen and for a scarce budget of T-follicular-helper signals; only the clones that bind better than their competitors receive help and re-enter for another mutation round, the rest die. Output is split into short-lived plasma cells (this run's answer) and memory B cells (carried forward to future encounters). Mechanisms to transfer: mutation of survivors rather than fresh sampling, a fixed target (the brief plus a frozen rubric) against which relative binding is measured, a strictly limited 'help' budget so critique and development tokens go only to ideas at the survival boundary, cyclic re-entry instead of a single pass, and a memory compartment that is the idea library.
